WHY NOW

As LendingTree adds verticals faster than ever, every new category depends on a consumer journey you can see from start to finish.

One View of the Full Consumer Journey

A single LendingTree visit often runs from an article to a form to offers.lendingtree.com, with offers opened in new tabs along the way. When each tab and subdomain is recorded separately, the product team only sees pieces of the experience.

How LogRocket helps

Multiple tabs and subdomains from the same visit are stitched into one continuous session — the full path from first page to final offer click plays back as a single journey.

Launching New Verticals with Confidence

Business, Pet, and RV Insurance are live, and more categories are on the way. On launch day, product owners need to know consumers reach the end state and nothing is broken, without watching sessions one at a time.

How LogRocket helps

Issues groups errors, failed requests, and frustration signals across every session on a new form and ranks them by consumer impact — a broken step shows up on day one, not after completions dip.

Engagement on a Mobile-First Marketplace

Most LendingTree traffic is mobile, and as more offers compete for space on every page, the team needs to know what consumers actually engage with to make placement decisions on real behavior, not assumptions.

How LogRocket helps

Aggregated click and scroll heatmaps, filtered to mobile and to a specific vertical, show how far consumers scroll and which offers they tap.

Knowing What's Worth Engineering

The product team constantly weighs which fixes and experiments deserve engineering time — answering "is this real, and does it affect enough consumers?" quickly, with evidence engineering trusts.

How LogRocket helps

Ask Galileo answers plain-language questions about consumer behavior across any vertical, config, or test, and links each answer to the sessions and metrics behind it.

PRODUCT FIT

Mapped to the journeys your team is already trying to understand and improve

SESSION REPLAY

What did this consumer's full visit actually look like?

Every session captures the consumer's screen across tabs and subdomains, alongside console logs, network requests, and timing. You can follow one consumer from lendingtree.com through a form and into offers, and confirm whether each step and external call worked.

Illustrative: a recorded LendingTree.com session — every page view, click, and network request in one continuous timeline.

JOURNEYS & FUNNELS

Where do consumers leave a new vertical's journey?

Build a funnel across pages, forms, and subdomains to see the conversion at each step. Then jump from any drop-off straight into the sessions behind it.

Illustrative RV Insurance funnel — 18,400 → 9,830 (47% drop) → 6,120 (38% drop) → 4,760 to offer click.

GALILEO AI

Is this a real problem, or an edge case?

Ask a question in plain language. Galileo reviews the matching sessions and returns a finding, the metrics behind it, and links to the sessions that support it.

Illustrative: “Business Insurance consumers leave at the coverage-selection step at 34% vs. 19% for Auto” — with the 12 supporting sessions linked.

ISSUES & HEATMAPS

What's hurting the most consumers right now, and what are they ignoring?

Issues ranks problems across all sessions by severity and consumer impact. Heatmaps show aggregated clicks and scroll depth for any page, device, or vertical.

Illustrative: offers page (mobile, Pet Insurance) — 68% scroll past the first offer; top issue is the offer carousel failing to advance on swipe, 1,240 consumers affected.
